submission_method: Proposals are to be submitted directly through the BCBid platform where the RFP is posted. No physical submission will be accepted unless specifically requested. Proposals must be submitted in the prescribed format, with all required forms and narrative responses provided in PDF format and pricing details and requirements submitted in Excel format.
contract_term: The contract will involve two parts: implementation and licensing. The term of the licensing and support agreement is for a period of five years, with an option in favour of Cowichan Tribes to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions.
scope_of_deliverables: Procurement of a cloud-based ERP system(s) to enhance operational efficiency across finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management. The solution must be commercially supported, provide automation features, and be adaptable to evolving business needs. Deliverables include a signed submission form, narrative response, pricing sheet, and requirements workbook.
mandatory_submission_requirements: 1. Proposal received by Submission Deadline via BCBid; 2. English language; 3. Signed Submission Form (PDF) from Appendix C; 4. Completed Narrative Response (PDF) per Appendix B Section A; 5. Completed Pricing Excel Workbook; 6. Completed Requirements Excel Workbook.
mandatory_technical_requirements: 1. Support for Canadian taxes and Canadian Payroll; 2. Vendor experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada; 3. Hosting and data storage within Canada; 4. At least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions; 5. Cloud-based solution; 6. SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent.
evaluation_criteria: Functional Fit (35 points, 80% threshold), Narrative Proposal (20 points, 70% threshold), Pricing (15 points, 70% threshold), and Vendor Demonstration (30 points, 70% threshold). Total Points: 100.
minimum_score_threshold: To advance to the next stage, a proposal must score at least 80% for functional fit (28 points). Additionally, vendors must meet the 70% thresholds for Narrative Proposal (14 points), Pricing (10.5 points), and Vendor Demonstration (21 points) as noted in the evaluation criteria table.
pricing_requirements: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes. Costs must be all-inclusive, including labour, materials, travel, insurance, delivery, installation, and set-up. Pricing must cover a 5-year period for implementation, licensing, and support.
minimum_insurance_requirements: Proponents must provide a letter or certificate of clearance from the Worker's Compensation Board demonstrating they are in good standing.
vendor_experience_qualifications: At least five years' experience implementing Finance, HR, Payroll, and Asset Management solutions. Vendor must have experience implementing solutions for First Nations in Canada.
number_of_references_required: At least two and at most five references for implementations involving the proposed solutions in Canada. Preference is for references to be First Nation clients. Each reference must include organization name, contact details, product description, services provided, and timeframe.
data_security_privacy_requirements: Solutions must be SOC2 Type 2 compliant or equivalent. Proponents must describe how proposed systems meet or exceed industry security standards and address privacy and cybersecurity risks.
data_hosting_residency_requirements: The solution must be hosted in Canada and store all data within Canada.
vendor_demonstration_requirement: Shortlisted vendors (top two or three) will be invited to a demonstration stage where they must present proposed solutions in accordance with a demo script provided by Cowichan Tribes. This stage is worth 30 points and has a 70% threshold (21 points).
